_language_help: One of the languages with a catalog at data/i18n/{lang}.json. Default: es.
_ebird_locale_help: Optional override for the eBird API locale (e.g. 'pt_BR'). If null, derived from `language`.
_description_policy_help: How to render descriptions when no source produces text in the configured language. One of: strict | foreign_fallback | skip. Default: foreign_fallback.
_rarity_bias_help: Strength of the bias towards rarer species in the daily draw. 0 = uniform (no bias), 0.5 = the template default, 1 = strong inverse-count bias, negative = favours the most abundant species. This instance draws uniformly on purpose: the count the bias reads is how many individuals were in a species' most recent reported sighting, which is noise about which checklist arrived last rather than a measure of how common the bird is. Set via BOTD_RARITY_BIAS.
_max_feed_entries_help: Entries in feed.xml. 0 = unlimited. With a cap, a second feed-full.xml carries the whole history. Set via BOTD_MAX_FEED_ENTRIES for Docker.
_feed_rebuild_all_help: Re-render every item body in feed-full.xml instead of reusing the published ones. Normally false: healed entries thaw on their own, so this is only for retroactive edits like a corrected common name. Set via BOTD_FEED_REBUILD_ALL.
_site_author_help: Author of this instance, shown in the footer and in the feed's copyright line. Required here: before the template split authorship in two, this name was hardcoded in the i18n catalogs, so leaving these empty would silently drop it from every page and from the feed. The template's own credit is separate and always shown. Set via BOTD_SITE_AUTHOR and BOTD_SITE_AUTHOR_URL.
_backfill_limit_help: Max healing actions (missed enrichments, failed GBIF lookups) retried per run. 0 disables self-healing.
_llm_help: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. 'models' are tried in order until one succeeds; pin concrete model names, not -latest aliases. API key via BOTD_LLM_API_KEY env var. 'judge' enables an optional second-pass fact-check.
